levers.how: Come forward at the citizens' forum or during a public hearing, in person or on Zoom (register on the city site before the meeting to get the link). State your full name and address and any organization you represent; address the Commission as a body.
levers.rules: Three minutes per speaker for the citizens' forum and for public hearings (Code of Ordinances Sec. 2-57). Longer matters need an appointment with the City Clerk before the meeting. Decorum rules in Sec. 2-58. Anyone may speak on any agenda item.
levers.deadline: Register for Zoom before the meeting starts

levers.how: No written comment procedure is posted. The Clerk's email (jflores@opalockafl.gov) is the posted contact for meeting questions.
Each elected official has a posted email (first initial plus last name at opalockafl.gov); the city main line is 305-953-2868.
